findings.reason: without a followup naming §69 the coordinator has no plan entry to dispatch it from, and the one open followup misstates the open set a reader would audit.
findings.text: §69 is declared `implementable` at :909/:27 but the plan carries only one open followup, `f-tsigah-066`, which recommends §3 and whose body says "§3, the suite runs bounded, in parallel and robust to load, is open beside §67 and §68" — §67 and §68 are now `done` and §69, the newly opened section, is named nowhere, so nothing in the queue recommends building it

findings.reason: a worker that judges `crew station` outside orchestration has no permitted route and must stop and report, so the plan should state that the four are fixed in docs/source only, or admit the one test edit.
findings.text: for `test_every_registered_crew_verb_is_documented_or_exempt` the code's own convention for a supervisor-launched verb is the exemption table (`("crew","host")` is exempt at tests/test_skill_contracts.py:1200 as "the session-host plugin's entry point … an orchestrator never invokes it", and `crew station` is launched by `fleet_supervisor` under a host lease at reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:2368), yet §69's write paths are `skills/` and `reckon/crew/directory.py` and its done-when requires the test file's diff to be empty, so the one route the convention supports is forbidden while the deliverable's "no exemption is added that the test does not already allow" reads as permitting it

findings.reason: naming the caller and the substitute decides whether the node removes a measurement or re-sources it, and the plan as written lets the cheapest path degrade production silently.
findings.text: the deliverable for `test_no_routing_identifier_leaks_into_skills_or_source` says only "bringing the documentation or source into line", but the identifiers sit in `_CONTEXT_WINDOWS` (reckon/crew/directory.py:50-57), whose sole consumer is `_context_window` at :202, and that is the only declared source of a session row's `window_tokens` and `fraction` — so deleting the table, the cheapest in-scope fix, turns a measured context fraction into "unmeasured" for every session and the plan neither names that cost nor the substitute that already exists (the runtime-reported `model_context_window` read at reckon/crew/rollout.py:482)
